title: Chocolate Chip Cookies II
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) white granulated sugar
1 pack (6 oz / 170 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips
steps: Combine the flour, salt, and baking powder.
Preheat the oven until it reaches 375°F/190°C.
In another bowl, cream the butter and sugars until light and fluffy.
Add egg and vanilla, and beat until smooth.
Mix in the flour mixture until well-blended.
Add the chocolate chips, and stir with a wooden spoon.
Drop the cookies onto a lightly-greased or parchment-lined cookie sheet by teaspoonfuls in 2-inch (5 cm) ball shapes.
Bake for 15 minutes or until the edges are light brown.
Remove the cookies from the cookie sheet with a metal spatula, then let them cool on a wire rack.
